results.title: spawn_blocking in tokio::task - Rust
results.content: Runs the provided closure on a thread where blocking is acceptable. In general, issuing a blocking call or performing a lot of compute in a future without yielding is problematic.

results.title: Spawning | Tokio - An asynchronous Rust runtime
results.content:
A Tokio task is an asynchronous green thread.
They are created by passing an async block to tokio::spawn.
A result without a title is shown under its address.
